questions.question: A transition animates:

options.text: A property's value change BETWEEN two states when it occurs

questions.explanation: Transitions interpolate when a property changes (e.g. :hover). For keyframe sequences, use animations.

questions.question: The minimum needed to see a transition is:
questions.explanation: Without a duration (default 0s) the change is instant. You need both the property to watch and a non-zero duration.

questions.question: transition: all 0.3s ease; will:

options.text: Animate all transitionable properties over 0.3s with ease timing

questions.explanation: Shorthand: transition: <property> <duration> <timing-function> <delay>. 'all' targets every animatable property (use specific props to avoid surprises).

questions.question: transition-timing-function: ease-in-out controls:

options.text: The acceleration curve (slow-fast-slow) of the transition
The number of times it repeats

questions.explanation: Timing functions (ease, linear, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier) shape the progress over time, not the duration/delay.

questions.question: A property will NOT transition if:

options.text: It has no intermediate computed value (e.g. display: none → block)

questions.explanation: Transitions need interpolatable values. display can't tween, so use opacity/visibility/transform for show-hide effects.

questions.question: Transitions vs animations: which can auto-run on page load without a state change?

options.text: Animations (keyframes auto-run); transitions need a trigger
Transitions auto-run; animations need a trigger

questions.explanation: Animations start automatically (or via animation-play-state). Transitions only fire when a property actually changes.

questions.question: transition-delay: 0.5s means:

options.text: The transition begins 0.5s AFTER the property change

questions.explanation: Delay postpones the start; duration (separate) sets how long the tween lasts.

questions.question: Good practice for hover transitions is:

options.text: Define the transition on the BASE state so both enter AND leave are smooth

questions.explanation: Putting transition on the base element means leaving :hover also animates back. Defining only on :hover makes the exit instant.
